title: Today’s Research Reports on Stocks to Watch: Apple and Boxlight
text:
https://www.rdinvesting.com/report/?ticker=BOXL
Apple Inc. shares closed up 4.42% on Wednesday with trading volume nearly 1.7 times compared to usual. The iPhone maker announced fiscal second quarter results on Tuesday that impressed Wall Street. For the quarter, revenue saw a growth of 16% to $61.1 billion while earnings per share saw a growth of 30% to $2.73. Analysts had been expecting revenue of $61 billion and earnings per share of $2.69. It was also on Tuesday that the company reported that its iPhone sales for the March quarter were slightly lower than what many had expected. Analysts had expected 53 million units but Apple reported 52.2 million. Apple also revealed that services revenue increased 31% year over year, and other products revenue increased 38% during the same period. CEO Tim Cook stated, “We’re now halfway through our fiscal 2018 with nearly $150 billion in revenues and double-digit growth in all of our geographic segments. We’ve generated almost $34 billion in earnings in six months, and we’re very bullish on Apple’s future. We have the best pipeline of products and services we’ve ever had.”

Boxlight Corporation shares skyrocketed yesterday to close up 107.87% on staggering volume compared to usual. The stock traded around 630,000 shares compared to an average of about 1,000 shares. Shares also hit a new high of $13.91 during intra-day trading on Wednesday. It was the day before that the leading provider of technology solutions for the global learning market, announced that it has two new touch technology products ready to ship to classrooms throughout the United States. One is the MimioFrame touch board kit that turns conventional whiteboards into touchboards in less than fifteen minutes. The other is the ProColor 490 Touch Table that allows up to four students to work on interactive lessons. The company’s CEO Mark Elliott remarked, “An additional benefit of MimioFrame is that the kit allows educators to resurrect aging interactive whiteboards as well as turn non-interactive whiteboard/projector combinations into modern interactive digital classrooms.” He also added, “Both of these touch devices were created to enhance student engagement and collaborative learning. Their intuitive functions mirror the way students interact with devices outside of the classroom, so students can dive right into learning.” The company will be reporting first quarter 2018 financial results on Tuesday, May 15th.
